items.t: GTA VI Needs To Hit $1.9B In Sales To Meet Investor Expectations, Says BofA – Analyst Sees 33% Potential Upside In TTWO Stock
items.sum: BofA estimates that GTA VI needs to generate at least $1.9 billion in sales to meet investors’ fiscal 2027 expectations.

items.t: Grand Theft Auto VI Makes Take-Two Stock Look Like a Steal
items.sum: GTA VI could be a cultural moment akin to Taylor Swift’s Eras Tour. This time, investors can buy stock ahead of the actual event.
